node.statement: Fresh/old target geometry from lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope. Put J={1,...,m}, F={j}, O=J minus F, e_U:=sum_{k in U}e_k, and P_U:=w(e_U); set P_fresh:=P_F and P_old:=P_O (with P_old=0 when m=1). Because epsilon<=e_env, lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope makes P_fresh a c_0^cb*epsilon-projection, makes P_old such a projection when O is nonempty (and 0 is exact when O is empty), makes A_fresh:=S_{P_fresh} an extended L*epsilon-C*-algebra and A_old:=S_{P_old} one when m>1, and bounds every required subordination and complementarity error for O,F subseteq J by L*epsilon. Moreover P_old+P_fresh=P_J exactly by linearity of w and e_O+e_F=e_J. Since K_1 dominates c_0^cb and L, all these projection and complementarity defects are at most t_1.
